layman_headline: Weak swing candidates and fearful markets mean patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 30/100, which is improving slightly from last week but still cautious. Bitcoin is up 3% on the week and holding $64,924, but its dominance at 56.8% means altcoins are struggling to attract capital. The swing trade candidates presented today are mostly obscure, low-liquidity tokens with no RSI, MACD, or volume data — making it impossible to build a high-conviction technical case. The stronger performers from the top-20 like SOL (+2.8% today) and ADA (+17.4% weekly) are interesting but already extended and weren't offered as formal swing candidates with full data.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. None of today's candidates have the data quality or setup clarity to justify risking capital. Watch for a pullback entry in SOL or ADA if they consolidate over the next few days.
expert_reasoning: All seven swing candidates suffer from critical data gaps — no RSI, no MACD cross, no volume-vs-average, and no SMA positioning. Without these core technical indicators, it's impossible to confirm oversold bounces or breakout setups, which are the foundation of reliable swing entries. BTW dropped 31% in 24h which screams risk not opportunity. PIEVERSE is up 23.5% in 7 days with a -49% ATH drawdown — classic pump-and-dump territory. Gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) are already extended +7% weekly and are hedges, not swing trades. The Fear & Greed index at 30 and improving is a setup for future entries, but without quality candidates the disciplined move is to wait. BTC dominance at 56.8% further suppresses alt upside.
risk_factors: All swing candidates lack RSI/MACD/volume data, making any entry a blind bet
BTC dominance at 56.8% continues to suppress altcoin performance broadly

ADA after its 17.4% weekly surge — watch for consolidation and whether it holds gains

market_context: Bitcoin is stabilizing around $64,900 with modest gains, while the Fear & Greed index at 30 is slowly recovering from deep fear. High BTC dominance at 56.8% keeps altcoin upside limited until rotation begins.
context_banner: Market fear is easing but swing candidates lack the technical data needed for a responsible entry — discipline demands patience.
